description: Use one case at a time in HAWK Test Flow. Dry runs intentionally return dry_run_requires_live_authority and take the exclusion branch without making CRM or SQL changes.

cases.name: Known imported CRM contact
expectedLiveRequirements: The contact maps to an OWL lead in the selected location.
The lead is in the configured Assigned lifecycle pool and has an assigned dialer user.
dncStatus is clean and phoneMarketingStatus is available.
Every configured service calendar is checked and has no active appointment.
Current marketing-hour and jurisdictional attempt rules allow the lead.
